newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-S&P puts NatMut on negative watch.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-S&P puts NatMut on negative watch.

text.p: Standard and Poor's Corp said on Friday it has placed the AA claims paying ability rating of National Mutual Life Association of Australasia Ltd on creditwatch with negative implications.
S&P said the action follows similar action in relation to the AXA SA general insurance group of France, the ultimate major shareholder in National Mutual.
S&P said the AA claims paying ability of National Mutual's New Zealand subsidiary, Swann Life Insurance Ltd, had also been placed on negative watch.
S&P said the action on AXA follows news that AXA and Union des Assurances de Paris (UAP) plan to merge. AXA holds a 51 percent stake in listed National Mutual Holdings Ltd.
"The negative creditwatch placement reflects a potential dilution of consolidated financial strength that may occur should the proposed merger go ahead," S&P said.
"Despite this action, NMLA and Swann Life remain financially strong and well structured to meet local obligations," the ratings agency said.
